journeys: Open the mobile global navigation drawer and receive focus on the active destination

rationale: Restores the existing mobile navigation focus-transfer contract: the active global destination receives focus when the drawer opens, with the first link retained as a fallback. This repairs an accessibility regression without adding, retiring, or expanding a product capability. The cross-capability declaration is recorded in Deepwater governance so its structural validation is selected without treating a generic evidence declaration as a full historical Homeport phase rerun.
